rungs.title: Junior Graphic Designer
rungs.summary: Learning the brand, the tools and the production process.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the brand identity, colour, type and the core tools.
rungs.delivery: Produces assets from a clear brief, reviewed before they go out.
rungs.leadership: Asks for feedback early and meets deadlines.

rungs.title: Graphic Designer
rungs.summary: Delivers on-brand design for print and screen on their own.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in the design system, layout and file preparation.
rungs.delivery: Takes a brief to a finished, on-brand piece with light review.
rungs.leadership: Explains design choices to non-designers and takes critique well.

rungs.title: Senior Graphic Designer
rungs.summary: Sets the look of a project and mentors others.
rungs.knowledge: Deep craft, AI-assisted image work and an eye for what is on brand.
rungs.delivery: Leads the look of campaigns and projects, start to finish.
rungs.leadership: Mentors juniors and builds trust with clients and colleagues.

rungs.title: Art Director
rungs.summary: Directs the visual quality of a body of work.
rungs.knowledge: Owns the visual language across campaigns, products and channels.
rungs.delivery: Directs designers and signs off the visual quality of what ships.
rungs.leadership: Leads projects and people; presents direction to leadership and clients.

rungs.title: Creative Director
rungs.summary: Owns creative strategy and the brand.
rungs.knowledge: Connects creative to the brand, the market and the numbers.
rungs.delivery: Owns creative strategy, budget and the standard of all output.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and is the public face of the brand's creative.
